# Files of Python MTEB 2.26.28

Python MTEB 2.26.28 wrote these files in its result cache, for the model `llama.cpp/embeddinggemma-2` on the task `zukhruf-gvc`. They end in `.txt` because the result holds `NaN` values, which are not JSON, and Prettier would refuse the file. The tests copy them into a cache folder under their real names.
